pattern: と言えなくもない（といえなくもない）
purpose: Allow a description while keeping some reservations.
keywords: Plain clause + と言えなくもない
This result could, in a sense, be called a success.
You could say it is a slightly unusual hobby.
It may be more convenient, but it is complicated to use.
formation: Plain clause + と言えなくもない
restrictions: The double negative expresses qualified agreement.
mistake: It is weaker than an unreserved と言える.
